e8/.alt: Card: E8, The E8 shadow with each root coloured by which of three eigenspaces it falls in: 84 amber, 78 teal, 78 rose.

gallery/.alt: Card: Gallery, Two hundred and forty dots in eight rings, every dot joined to fifty-six others by faint lines, the whole thing turning about a dark centre with thirty-fold symmetry. The dots come in three colours: amber, teal and rose.

triality/.alt: Card: Triality, Twenty-four dots in three colours with three-fold symmetry: a third of a turn carries each colour onto the next.

wheel/.alt: Card: The Wheel, Seven labelled circles at the corners, edge midpoints and centre of a triangle, joined by three sides, three medians and one inner circle, with arrows around each line.
